name: LogSentinel Agent
description: An AI agent that scans a folder of log files, reads only the lines added since the last scan, classifies and explains the errors (root cause, impact, fix), and drafts alert emails for critical failures that are sent only after human approval.
target_audience: DevOps Engineers, SRE, On-call Developers, IT Support
tasks_capable_of_performing: Incremental Log Folder Scanning (new lines only)
Root Cause Analysis with Fix Recommendations
Critical Alert Email Drafting with Human Approval
Error Explanation with Stack Overflow Sources
examples_of_suitable_questions: Check the logs in C:\logs\webapp from the beginning
What does ECONNREFUSED mean and how do I fix it?
Why does nginx return 502 Bad Gateway?
